value.signature: fn refuse (& mut self , label : & NamespaceLabel , major : u64 , from_minor : u64)

review.body: { let Some (majors) = self . lines . get_mut (label) else { return ; } ; let Some (line) = majors . get_mut (& major) else { return ; } ; line . entries . retain (| (minor , _) | * minor < from_minor) ; if line . entries . is_empty () { majors . remove (& major) ; if majors . is_empty () { self . lines . remove (label) ; } } else { line . remember_companion () ; } }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for registry::Registry::refuse.
